_comment: The single filing behind the /guide screenshots on the marketing site.
It is the SAME fictional filer as the sample output on /services: Test LLC,
Test Owner, EIN 07-1234567, tax year 2025, the same three transactions. One
fictional filer across the whole site, so /services and /guide never tell two
different stories. Do not invent a second fixture, and do not edit this one
without editing scripts/genSamplePreview.mjs in the same commit.
The EIN prefix 07 is not issued by the IRS, so it cannot collide with a real
employer identification number. 'Test LLC' and 'Test Owner' read as fictional
on purpose: nobody should mistake a screenshot for a real filer's return.
IT WAS 00-1234567 UNTIL 8 AUGUST 2026, AND THE PRODUCT REJECTS THAT. The 00
prefix was chosen for exactly the reason above, but Intake.tsx einProblem()
refuses it: 'An EIN cannot begin with 00'. Nobody noticed because this fixture
is written STRAIGHT TO THE DATABASE by seedGuideFixture, which never touches
the intake's validation, so the one EIN printed across every published sample
was one no filer could type in. Found by entering this fixture through the UI.
07 keeps the original intent, is never issued by the IRS, and passes.
The sample PDFs on /services still show the old EIN until genSamplePreview
and genSampleRcl are re-run. Do that before trusting them.
include_reasonable_cause and include_rcl are BOTH true, unlike the /services
sample, so the generate step's What's Included list names the letter. That is
the $199 line item and the screen where a filer decides to pay for it.
